function.name: get_link_status
function.description: Read negotiated PCIe link speed, width and LTSSM state for a switch port on an Atlas3/HYDRA card.

function.name: set_port_power
function.description: Enable or disable slot power for a downstream port. WRITE-level action.

function.name: i3c_entdaa
function.description: Run ENTDAA dynamic address assignment on an I3C bus.
